title: Outside AI Agents Aren’t Slowing Google And Amazon Ads. Their Own Are.
summary: Google and Amazon ad growth slowed, but outside AI agents aren’t the cause. The drag comes from their own AI assistants, which they haven’t fully monetized yet.
